name: Replit
description: Replit's MCP server lets users create, update, and manage full-stack web and mobile applications directly from Claude using natural language. Powered by Replit Agent, it transforms prompts into live, deployed apps — complete with databases, authentication, and custom domains. Users can iterate on their apps conversationally, ask the Agent questions about their project, and access a live preview URL as the app builds. No coding experience required. The server supports OAuth 2.0 authentication and Streamable HTTP transport, integrating seamlessly with Replit's cloud development platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Replit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Replit to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://replit-mcp.com/anthropic/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Replit MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replit provides these MCP tools: create_app_from_prompt, resolve_app_by_name, update_app_using_prompt, ask_question, and import-claude-design-from-url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Replit?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Replit in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Replit requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Replit is developed by Replit. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
